summary: Iteration 13 — Patient treatments & sessions (عيادتي). Backend 5/5 pytest passed (create treatment with auto initial session, add follow-up, list newest-first, 404 on unknown treatment, unauth rejected). Frontend E2E on /patient/{id} verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844) with doctor@demo.com: FDI chart loads, save-treatment-btn is aria-disabled with 0 teeth selected then enables to 'حفظ المعالجة (2 سن)' after selecting palette-caries + tooth-16/17 (selection outline borderColor rgb(74,112,101) borderWidth 2px verified). Pressing save creates a treatment (POST /api/patients/{pid}/treatments), colors both teeth with the caries color, resets selection outline (border reverts to rgb(176,196,188) 1px) and resets activeCondition back to 'سليم' (healthy). The sessions modal opens automatically showing sess-item-0 (initial 'تسوس' session with today's date). Tapping add-session-btn shows sess-name-input/sess-note-input, saving via sess-save-btn appends sess-item-1 immediately (session texts confirmed). Treatments log below the chart shows the created treatment; tapping treatment-{id} reopens the same sessions modal. RTL layout preserved. No blocking issues.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' (originates from styles in patient screen / cards). Non-blocking; upgrade when convenient.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* styles to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings (not required for this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: patient/[id].tsx is 597 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider extracting the FDI chart + Sessions modal into subcomponents in a future iteration.
saveTreatment issues N separate PUT /api/patients/{id}/teeth calls in a loop before creating the treatment; acceptable for small selections (≤4) but a bulk endpoint would reduce round-trips.

server.py create_treatment does not verify that the patient belongs to the tenant before inserting the treatment (only tenant_id is added to the doc). Consider a preflight patients lookup like the xray endpoint to reject unknown patient IDs with 404.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test treatment on demo doctor's first patient via UI flow (kept — cheap to remove from treatments collection if desired).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses testID 'login-submit-button' (NOT 'login-submit'). Demo doctor first patient id used: 68bef310-292a-4b89-bf90-577507a63ed0. FDI teeth: [data-testid=tooth-{n}]; palette chips: [data-testid=palette-{condition}]; save: save-treatment-btn (aria-disabled='true' when no selection); sessions modal: sess-item-{i}, add-session-btn, sess-name-input, sess-note-input, sess-save-btn, sess-close; log rows: treatment-{id}.
